items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was playing for those guys... Billie Williams. And these fellows had quite a variety of vocal arrangements

ctx.x: You were? I'm thinking of another group, then.

Sure. Billie Williams. And these fellows had quite a variety of vocal arrangements, and were very busy with radio. We were on the radio five times a week; they had three days a week for commercial, for a vapor rub product,

cold remedies and things like that -- we were on NBC three days a week and two days a week on WOR, the mutual network, and I was playing for those guys, and also I was the intermission piano player at the Famous Door on 52nd Street -- the first of the jazz clubs, and it had gotten opened by a bunch of musicians; I think Lennie Hayton was one of them; a lot of musicians went together and bought this little place.
